facts.finding: F32 input/output promotion, scale in input dtype, QK, finite-min Boolean where, precise softmax, PV stay F32; no explicit narrowing to Half/BF16 is present on this math path. GQA reshapes/broadcasts do not change dtype.

KV8193 selects looped float softmax. precise=true does not promote F32 to FP64. Kernel normalizer and stored probabilities are float; source uses fast exponential. For this all-equal row, integer counts through 8193 fit exactly in F32, so ordinary probability rounding is a much smaller candidate than PV accumulation, subject to checking actual probability bits.

Metal GEMM carries float operands and float accumulator fragments through simdgroup multiply-accumulate; repeated K tiles accumulate into those fragments. NAX requires availability plus TF32 opt-in for F32. Air/no-NAX rules that route out. Exact batch collapsing and the runtime pipeline have not been captured, so this is source evidence for F32 reduction, not an instruction trace or a guarantee of summation order.

The failed query row has an entirely false Boolean mask. Every QK score is replaced by the same finite F32 minimum. Its expected output is therefore the full-KV mean; QK error is not needed to explain this scalar. V alternates +1.25/-1.25 plus head/channel offset; head0/channel0 offset is -0.125, so repeated weighted addition carries a nonzero bias over 8193 terms.
